sequence_description: SAML assertion missing <Conditions> (no time bounds, no audience restriction) should be rejected; acceptance would over-grant beyond BrokerPolicy(config) and upstream intent constraints.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_nocond_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_nocond_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted SAML assertion without <Conditions> (no time/audience bounds), enabling authorization beyond intended constraints.

sequence_description: I5: If SAML assertion omits Conditions (no time/audience bounds) and is accepted, then attempt token exchange requesting broader scope; either step succeeding indicates authorization binding weakness.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_nocond_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_nocond_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted SAML assertion without Conditions, granting a session without time/audience constraints (authorization binding failure).

sequence_description: Two OAuth clients share the same client_secret; attempt to exchange a token minted for client-A at client-B to obtain a token for client-B (cross-client authorization confusion).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_shared_b_exchanged_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_shared_b_exchanged_http_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Client-B accepted token exchange using a subject_token minted for client-A (cross-client authorization confusion), enabling permissions beyond upstream intent.

sequence_description: Control SAML login then submit an expired SAML assertion; if accepted, it grants a session outside upstream time-bounds (authorization binding failure).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_saml_time_expired_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_saml_time_expired_http_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted an expired SAML assertion, granting a session outside upstream time bounds (authorization binding failure).
